def mine_line(xs, y, label):
    outs = []
    for x in xs:
        move_to(Position(x=x, y=y-4))
        d = place_entity(Prototype.ElectricMiningDrill, position=Position(x=x, y=y), direction=Direction.UP)
        f = place_entity_next_to(Prototype.ElectricFurnace, d.position, direction=Direction.UP, spacing=0)
        i = place_entity_next_to(Prototype.Inserter, f.position, direction=Direction.UP, spacing=0)
        if i.drop_position.y > i.position.y:
            i = rotate_entity(i, Direction.UP)
        print(label, "drill", d.position, d.drop_position, d.resources, "furn", f.position, "ins", i.position, i.pickup_position, i.drop_position)
        outs.append((d, f, i))
    return outs

def ensure(proto, pos, direction):
    try:
        e = get_entity(proto, pos)
        if e is not None and abs(e.position.x-pos.x)<0.6 and abs(e.position.y-pos.y)<0.6:
            return e
    except Exception:
        pass
    place_entity(proto, position=pos, direction=direction)
    return get_entity(proto, pos)
